# Getting help

| You want to                                      | Where                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Learn how to use ConsulX                         | the [README](../README.md), the [examples](../examples) and the [API reference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/jhonsferg/consulx) |
| Run it in production                             | [docs/production.md](../docs/production.md)                                                                                      |
| Check Consul version support                     | [docs/compatibility.md](../docs/compatibility.md)                                                                                |
| Migrate from `consul/api` or Spring Cloud Consul | [docs/migration.md](../docs/migration.md)                                                                                        |
| Ask a usage question                             | open a [question](https://github.com/jhonsferg/consulx/issues/new?template=question.yml)                                         |
| Report a bug                                     | open a [bug report](https://github.com/jhonsferg/consulx/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)                                     |
| Propose a feature                                | open a [feature request](https://github.com/jhonsferg/consulx/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)                           |
| Report a security problem                        | privately, following the [security policy](../SECURITY.md)                                                                       |

Before opening an issue, search the
[existing issues](https://github.com/jhonsferg/consulx/issues?q=is%3Aissue)
and include the ConsulX, Go and Consul versions you use.
